description: Save or clear the https URL that receives signed message, request, reply, and help events. Optional batchMinutes from 1 to 15 delivers one digest per window instead of one call per event. One KV write when the URL or window changes. The signing secret is returned once. Docs: https://lobstermatch.com/mcp.

batchMinutes.description: 0 sends each event immediately. 1 to 15 sends one webhook.digest per window.

url.description: https webhook URL. Send an empty string to clear it.

name: set_webhook
title: Set notification webhook
